```{r knitr-setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE,
                      fig.width = 9, fig.height = 6, dpi = 150,
                      cache = TRUE, cache.lazy = FALSE, fig.path = "out/cache/")
options(scipen = 999)
```

> **What this file is.** A single runnable pipeline that *acquires, wrangles, checks, integrates and
> explores* every dataset for the project, saving each figure to `out/` and printing every number
> the report cites. It is the material the report is written from.
>
> **How to run it.** Put the supplied files where §0 expects them (the two Transport-Activity CSVs,
> the mobile-camera `.xlsx` and the bike-routes `.csv`), then knit. The first knit performs the
> reproducible fixed-camera scrape, downloads the municipal boundary, geocodes the mobile sites
> (cached to CSV), and aggregates the 8.2 M-row activity series. All computation is in the projected
> CRS **EPSG:7855**.

# Setup {#setup}

```{r packages}
## install-if-missing, then load
pkgs <- c("sf","dplyr","tidyr","stringr","readr","readxl","purrr","tibble","data.table","lubridate",
          "httr2","jsonlite","geojsonsf","ggplot2","scales","patchwork","RColorBrewer","viridisLite","classInt",
          "spdep","sfnetworks","tidygraph","igraph","cluster","tidygeocoder","zoo")
to_install <- setdiff(pkgs, rownames(installed.packages()))
if (length(to_install)) install.packages(to_install, repos = "https://cloud.r-project.org")
invisible(lapply(pkgs, require, character.only = TRUE))
set.seed(5147)
for (d in c("data_raw","cache","out")) dir.create(d, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

```{r config}
## ---- coordinate reference systems -------------------------------------------------------------
## Source data are WGS84 lon/lat (degrees). Degrees are NOT a length unit, so EVERY distance, length,
## area and density is computed in a PROJECTED CRS in metres.
CRS_WGS  <- 4326    # source lon/lat
CRS_WORK <- 7855    # GDA2020 / MGA Zone 55 (metres) — Melbourne — ALL computation

## ---- local input paths (EDIT to match your machine) -------------------------------------------
TAC_FILES <- c(
  "/Users/chipi/Desktop/MONASH/Sem2_26/FIT5147/assignments/ASS1/dataset/TransportActivityCount_2026/TransportActivityCount_2026-1.csv",
  "/Users/chipi/Desktop/MONASH/Sem2_26/FIT5147/assignments/ASS1/dataset/TransportActivityCount_2026/TransportActivityCount_2026-2.csv")
MOBILE_XLSX <- "/Users/chipi/Downloads/data_dep/Mobile-Camera-Locations-April-2026.xlsx"
BIKE_CSV    <- "/Users/chipi/Downloads/data_dep/bicycle-routes-including-informal-on-road-and-off-road-routes.csv"

## ---- one palette per variable-role (consistency = a design-justification mark) ----------------
PAL_SEQ  <- "YlGnBu"                                   # sequential (activity): ColorBrewer, CVD-safe
CAM_COL  <- c(fixed = "#D55E00", mobile = "#0072B2")   # Okabe–Ito: enforcement kind (categorical)
MODE_COL <- c(pedestrian = "#009E73", cyclist = "#CC79A7", escooter = "#E69F00")  # Okabe–Ito
PROT_PAL <- c("1 Off-road / trail"="#081d58","2 Separated on-road"="#225ea8","3 Painted on-road"="#41b6c4",
              "4 Part-time (peak only)"="#7fcdbb","5 Informal / mixed traffic"="#c7e9b4","6 Strategic corridor"="#bdbdbd")
theme_map <- function() theme_void(base_size = 11) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face="bold"), legend.position = "right")
theme_dep <- function() theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), plot.title = element_text(face="bold"))
ggsave2 <- function(name, plot, w=9, h=6) ggplot2::ggsave(file.path("out",name), plot, width=w, height=h, dpi=150, bg="white")
```

# Data acquisition {#acquire}

## Fixed cameras — reproducible scrape from the Victorian Government feed {#scrape}

The "Find a road safety camera" tool (`vic.gov.au/find-road-safety-camera`) renders client-side, so
its records never appear in the page HTML. Inspecting the page's network traffic (DevTools → Network
→ XHR) reveals the underlying **Elasticsearch `_search` endpoint**. A single `POST` with a
`match_all` query and `size = 1000` returns **all 333 records** as JSON, which we flatten to a tidy,
ready-to-process CSV. This is the genuine "data collection" complexity for Criterion 1, and it is
fully reproducible.

```{r scrape-fixed}
fx_csv <- "data_raw/fixed_cameras_scraped.csv"
if (!file.exists(fx_csv)) {
  ep <- "https://www.vic.gov.au/api/tide/elasticsearch/content-vic__production__sdp_data_pipelines_scl/_search"
  resp <- request(ep) |>
    req_method("POST") |>
    req_body_raw('{"size":1000,"query":{"match_all":{}}}', type = "application/json") |>
    req_user_agent("Monash DEP student project (reproducible academic re-download)") |>
    req_timeout(60) |>
    req_perform()
  hits <- resp_body_json(resp, simplifyVector = FALSE)$hits$hits
  src  <- lapply(hits, function(h) {
    s <- h[["_source"]]; s[vapply(s, is.null, logical(1))] <- NA
    as.data.frame(s, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)
  })
  fx_raw <- dplyr::bind_rows(src)
  readr::write_csv(fx_raw, fx_csv)
} else fx_raw <- readr::read_csv(fx_csv, show_col_types = FALSE)
message("Fixed cameras scraped: ", nrow(fx_raw), " rows x ", ncol(fx_raw), " cols")   # 333 x 24
```

## Municipal boundary (Dataset D — the authoritative clip mask) {#boundary}

```{r dl-boundary}
com_geojson <- "data_raw/municipal-boundary.geojson"
if (!file.exists(com_geojson))
  download.file("https://data.melbourne.vic.gov.au/api/explore/v2.1/catalog/datasets/municipal-boundary/exports/geojson",
                com_geojson, mode = "wb", quiet = TRUE)
com   <- st_read(com_geojson, quiet = TRUE) |> st_transform(CRS_WORK) |> st_make_valid()
com_u <- st_union(com)
message("CoM area: ", round(as.numeric(st_area(com_u))/1e6, 1), " km^2")   # 37.7
```

# Wrangle B1 — Fixed cameras {#b1}

Raw is **333 × 23–24, statewide Victoria** (lat −38.4 … −34.2). Drop 100%-null columns, keep the one
discriminating categorical (`site_type`), project and **clip to the CoM polygon** (333 → 29).

```{r wrangle-fixed}
fx <- fx_raw
## Evidence-driven column triage (reproduced facts, not assumptions)
blank <- function(x) is.na(x) | trimws(as.character(x)) == ""
null_cols  <- names(fx)[vapply(fx, function(x) all(blank(x)), logical(1))]        # lga, commissioned_date, network
const_cols <- names(fx)[vapply(fx, function(x) dplyr::n_distinct(x[!blank(x)]) == 1, logical(1))]  # camera_type, reason, link, status
message("null cols: ", paste(null_cols, collapse=", "),
        " | constant cols: ", paste(const_cols, collapse=", "))

fx <- fx |>
  transmute(camera_id, suburb, street, offence_location, intersects_with, site_type,
            latitude = as.numeric(latitude), longitude = as.numeric(longitude),
            test_date   = as.Date(last_annual_test, "%d/%m/%Y"),   # COMPLIANCE date, NOT enforcement time
            expiry_date = as.Date(expiry_date,      "%d/%m/%Y"))
stopifnot(!any(duplicated(fx$camera_id)))
fx_sf  <- st_as_sf(fx, coords = c("longitude","latitude"), crs = CRS_WGS) |> st_transform(CRS_WORK)
fx_com <- fx_sf[com_u, ]                                                        # authoritative clip
message("Fixed: ", nrow(fx_sf), " statewide -> ", nrow(fx_com), " in CoM")      # 333 -> 29
print(count(st_drop_geometry(fx_com), site_type))                              # Intersection 26, Highway 3
```

# Wrangle B2 — Mobile cameras {#b2}

Raw is **2,252 × 4** after the title row, with **no coordinates** and **588 corrupt
`Audit Date = "T"`** tokens. Filter to CoM suburbs (2,252 → 28), **geocode** (ArcGIS via
`tidygeocoder`, cached), then accuracy-check against the boundary (28 → 18; the boundary test
catches a gross geocoding error).

```{r wrangle-mobile}
COM_SUBS <- c("MELBOURNE","CARLTON","CARLTON NORTH","DOCKLANDS","EAST MELBOURNE","KENSINGTON",
              "NORTH MELBOURNE","PARKVILLE","SOUTHBANK","SOUTH YARRA","WEST MELBOURNE","FLEMINGTON","PORT MELBOURNE")
mb <- readxl::read_excel(MOBILE_XLSX, skip = 1)                                 # skip title row
names(mb) <- c("location","suburb","reason_code","audit_date")
mb <- mb |> mutate(
  suburb   = str_squish(toupper(suburb)),
  audit_is_T = trimws(as.character(audit_date)) == "T",                         # corrupt token
  audit_month = suppressWarnings(my(ifelse(audit_is_T, NA, as.character(audit_date)))),
  location = location |> str_squish() |> str_replace_all("\\bRd\\b","Road") |>
             str_replace_all("\\bSt\\b","Street") |> str_replace_all("\\bAve\\b","Avenue") |>
             str_replace_all("\\bPde\\b","Parade") |> str_replace_all("\\bHwy\\b","Highway"))
message("Mobile rows: ", nrow(mb), " | 'T' tokens: ", sum(mb$audit_is_T, na.rm=TRUE))   # 2252 | 588
for (L in c("A","B","C","D")) mb[[paste0("reason_",L)]] <- str_detect(coalesce(mb$reason_code,""), L)
mb_com <- mb |> filter(suburb %in% COM_SUBS) |>
  mutate(addr = paste0(location, ", ", str_to_title(suburb), ", VIC, Australia"))
message("CoM-suburb rows: ", nrow(mb_com), " | 'T' among them: ", sum(mb_com$audit_is_T, na.rm=TRUE))  # 28 | 6

geo_cache <- "cache/geocoded_mobile.csv"
if (!file.exists(geo_cache)) {
  gc <- mb_com |> tidygeocoder::geocode(address = addr, method = "arcgis", lat = lat, long = lon)
  readr::write_csv(gc, geo_cache)
} else gc <- readr::read_csv(geo_cache, show_col_types = FALSE)
message("Geocode match rate: ", round(100*mean(!is.na(gc$lat)), 1), "%")        # 100%

mb_geo <- gc |> filter(!is.na(lat)) |>
  st_as_sf(coords = c("lon","lat"), crs = CRS_WGS) |> st_transform(CRS_WORK)
mb_com_sf <- mb_geo[com_u, ]                                                    # accuracy check: inside CoM
message("Mobile geocoded ", nrow(mb_geo), " -> in-boundary ", nrow(mb_com_sf),
        " (", nrow(mb_geo)-nrow(mb_com_sf), " dropped incl. the mis-geocoded 'Chapel St, South Yarra')")
```

# Wrangle C — Bicycle routes {#c}

Parse the `Geo Shape` GeoJSON to line geometry, derive an **ordinal protection** variable (a
modelling choice — physical separation from traffic), an `existing`/`proposed` flag, and per-segment
lengths. Totals: **274 features, 198.4 km, 39 proposed**.

```{r wrangle-bike}
braw <- readr::read_csv(BIKE_CSV, show_col_types = FALSE)
geom <- st_sfc(lapply(braw$`Geo Shape`, function(s) st_geometry(geojsonsf::geojson_sf(s))[[1]]), crs = CRS_WGS)
bk <- st_sf(dplyr::select(braw, -`Geo Shape`, -`Geo Point`), geometry = geom) |>
      st_transform(CRS_WORK) |> st_make_valid()
bk <- bk |> mutate(
  name = coalesce(as.character(name), ""), type = as.character(type),
  protection = dplyr::case_when(
    str_detect(name, regex("Part-Time", ignore_case=TRUE))                        ~ "4 Part-time (peak only)",
    str_detect(name, regex("Kerbside|Double Chevron|Separated", ignore_case=TRUE))~ "2 Separated on-road",
    type == "Off-Road Bike Route"                                                 ~ "1 Off-road / trail",
    type == "On-Road Bike Lane"                                                   ~ "3 Painted on-road",
    type == "Informal Bike Route"                                                 ~ "5 Informal / mixed traffic",
    type == "Corridor"                                                            ~ "6 Strategic corridor",
    TRUE                                                                          ~ "5 Informal / mixed traffic"),
  protection = factor(protection, levels = names(PROT_PAL), ordered = TRUE),
  existing   = ifelse(is.na(status) | trimws(status)=="", "Existing", "Proposed"),
  length_m   = as.numeric(st_length(geometry)))
message("Bike: ", nrow(bk), " features · ", round(sum(bk$length_m)/1000,1), " km · ",
        sum(!st_is_valid(bk)), " invalid · ", sum(bk$existing=="Proposed"), " proposed")
print(bk |> st_drop_geometry() |> group_by(protection) |>
        summarise(n=n(), km=round(sum(length_m)/1000,1), .groups="drop"))
```

# Wrangle A — Transport Activity Counts (big data + a timezone finding) {#a}

Two quarterly CSVs (\~1.27 GB, **8,205,370 rows**, 1 Jan–12 May 2026) read with `data.table::fread`.

> **Checking finding (documented).** The `from` timestamps are labelled with a `Z` (UTC) suffix but
> are in fact **Melbourne local wall-clock time**. Converting them from UTC displaces every temporal
> pattern by 10–11 h — it puts the *cyclist* peak at 3–4 a.m., which is physically impossible and is
> how the error was caught. We therefore strip the `Z` and parse the wall-clock **as local time**
> (no conversion).

```{r wrangle-tac}
tac <- data.table::rbindlist(lapply(TAC_FILES, data.table::fread,
        select = c("countLocationId","CountLocationLat","CountLocationLong","from","class","count")))
## LOCAL-TIME parse (see finding above): strip 'Z', treat wall-clock as Australia/Melbourne
tac[, ts   := lubridate::ymd_hms(sub("Z$", "", from), tz = "Australia/Melbourne", quiet = TRUE)]
tac <- tac[!is.na(ts)]
tac[, `:=`(hour = hour(ts), dow = wday(ts, week_start = 1), date = as_date(ts),
           class = tolower(trimws(class)), count = as.numeric(count))]
## 159 countlines occupy only 35 distinct coordinates -> aggregate to SENSOR SITES
tac[, site := paste(round(CountLocationLat,5), round(CountLocationLong,5), sep = "_")]
message("TAC rows: ", format(nrow(tac), big.mark=","), " | dates ",
        as.character(min(tac$date)), "–", as.character(max(tac$date)),
        " | distinct sites: ", data.table::uniqueN(tac$site))

VRU <- c("pedestrian","cyclist")
## per-site VRU totals + coverage
site_tot <- tac[class %in% c(VRU,"escooter"),
                .(count = sum(count, na.rm=TRUE)), by=.(site, CountLocationLat, CountLocationLong, class)]
site_wide <- dcast(site_tot, site + CountLocationLat + CountLocationLong ~ class, value.var="count", fill=0)
site_wide[, vru := pedestrian + cyclist]
cov <- tac[, .(n_int = uniqueN(as.integer(as.numeric(ts))%/%300), n_rows=.N,
               span = (max(as.integer(as.numeric(ts)))-min(as.integer(as.numeric(ts))))%/%300 + 1),
           by = site]
cov[, coverage := pmin(n_int/span, 1)]
site_wide <- merge(site_wide, cov[,.(site,coverage)], by="site")
## per-site hour x dow profile (VRU), daily series, and time-of-day slices
prof  <- tac[class %in% VRU, .(count=sum(count,na.rm=TRUE)), by=.(site, class, hour, dow)]
daily <- tac[class %in% VRU, .(count=sum(count,na.rm=TRUE)), by=.(date, class)]
tac[, slice := fcase(hour %in% 7:9,"AM peak (7-9)", hour %in% 10:15,"Midday (10-15)",
                     hour %in% 16:18,"PM peak (16-18)", default="Evening/night")]
tslice <- tac[class %in% VRU, .(count=sum(count,na.rm=TRUE)), by=.(site, slice)]

sites <- st_as_sf(site_wide, coords = c("CountLocationLong","CountLocationLat"), crs = CRS_WGS) |>
         st_transform(CRS_WORK)
sites <- sites[com_u, ]
message("Sensor sites in CoM: ", nrow(sites), " | total VRU: ", format(sum(sites$vru), big.mark=","))
```

# Integration — one analysis-ready surface {#integrate}

All layers in EPSG:7855. Union the cameras, compute each site's distance to the nearest camera and
its nearest-route protection level, and the protected metres within a 200 m buffer.

```{r integrate}
cam <- rbind(transmute(fx_com, kind="fixed",  site_type=as.character(site_type)),
             transmute(mb_com_sf, kind="mobile", site_type=NA_character_))
cam_u <- st_union(cam)
sites$cam_dist <- as.numeric(st_distance(sites, cam_u))                          # nearest-camera distance
## nearest existing route + its protection ordinal
bk_ex <- bk |> filter(existing == "Existing")
ni <- st_nearest_feature(sites, bk_ex)
sites$near_prot <- bk_ex$protection[ni]
## protected metres (existing off-road/separated) within 200 m of each site
prot_strong <- st_union(bk_ex |> filter(protection %in% c("1 Off-road / trail","2 Separated on-road")))
## per-site protected metres within 200 m (looped so the result stays aligned to `sites`)
sites$prot_m_200 <- vapply(st_geometry(st_buffer(sites, 200)), function(b)
  as.numeric(sum(st_length(suppressWarnings(st_intersection(prot_strong, b))))), numeric(1))
message("median site->camera distance: ", round(median(sites$cam_dist)), " m (max ",
        round(max(sites$cam_dist)), " m)")                                      # median 526, max 1180
```

# Exploration — figures {#explore}

## F1 · Study-area overview {#f1}

```{r f1}
F1 <- ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data=com, fill="#f4f4f2", colour="#8a8a8a", linewidth=0.5) +
  geom_sf(data=bk, aes(colour=existing, linetype=existing), linewidth=0.4) +
  geom_sf(data=sites, shape=21, fill="#333333", colour="white", size=1.6, stroke=.2) +
  geom_sf(data=cam, aes(shape=kind), colour="black", size=2) +
  scale_colour_manual(values=c(Existing="#7fbf7b", Proposed="#af8dc3"), name="Bike route") +
  scale_linetype_manual(values=c(Existing="solid", Proposed="22"), guide="none") +
  scale_shape_manual(values=c(fixed=17, mobile=15), name="Camera") +
  labs(title="F1 · Study area — City of Melbourne") + theme_map()
ggsave2("F1_overview.png", F1); F1
```

## F2 · Signature — classed proportional symbols + linked histogram {#f2}

Activity is measured at 35 discrete sites, so it is shown as **classed proportional symbols** (an
honest idiom for point data), classified with **Jenks natural breaks** (the distribution is heavily
right-skewed). The same breaks are drawn on the histogram so distribution maps onto space (Applied
W4).

```{r f2}
brks <- classInt::classIntervals(sites$vru, n=5, style="jenks")$brks
sites$act_cls <- cut(sites$vru, brks, include.lowest=TRUE)
pal5 <- RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(5, PAL_SEQ)
## scheme comparison (evidence for the Jenks choice)
scheme_tab <- purrr::map_dfr(c("equal","quantile","jenks"), function(s)
  tibble(scheme=s, breaks=paste(round(classInt::classIntervals(sites$vru,5,style=s)$brks/1e6,2), collapse=" | ")))
print(scheme_tab)
g_hist <- ggplot(sites, aes(vru, fill=act_cls)) +
  geom_histogram(bins=18, colour="white", linewidth=.2) +
  geom_vline(xintercept=brks[-c(1,length(brks))], linetype=2, colour="grey50") +
  scale_fill_manual(values=pal5, guide="none") +
  scale_x_continuous(labels=label_number(scale=1e-6, suffix="M")) +
  labs(title="F2a · Site VRU distribution with Jenks breaks", x="VRU total (Jan–May 2026)", y="sites") + theme_dep()
g_map <- ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data=com, fill="#f4f4f2", colour="#8a8a8a", linewidth=.5) +
  geom_sf(data=sites, aes(size=vru, fill=act_cls), shape=21, colour="black", stroke=.3, alpha=.92) +
  geom_sf(data=cam, aes(shape=kind), size=1.7) +
  scale_fill_manual(values=pal5, name="VRU (Jenks)") + scale_size_area(max_size=11, guide="none") +
  scale_shape_manual(values=c(fixed=17, mobile=15), name="Camera") +
  labs(title="F2b · VRU activity at sensor sites + cameras") + theme_map()
F2 <- g_hist / g_map + patchwork::plot_layout(heights=c(1,2.4)); ggsave2("F2_activity_signature.png", F2, h=10); F2
```

## F3 · Bivariate activity × enforcement-proximity {#f3}

```{r f3}
tert <- function(x) as.integer(cut(rank(x, ties.method="first"), 3, labels=FALSE))
sites$x3 <- tert(sites$vru); sites$y3 <- tert(-sites$cam_dist)      # near camera = high
bipal <- c("1-1"="#e8e8e8","2-1"="#e4acac","3-1"="#c85a5a","1-2"="#b0d5df","2-2"="#ad9ea5",
           "3-2"="#985356","1-3"="#64acbe","2-3"="#627f8c","3-3"="#574249")
sites$bi <- paste(sites$x3, sites$y3, sep="-")
F3 <- ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data=com, fill="#f4f4f2", colour="#8a8a8a", linewidth=.5) +
  geom_sf(data=sites, aes(fill=bi), shape=21, size=3, colour="black", stroke=.3, show.legend=FALSE) +
  geom_sf(data=cam, aes(shape=kind), size=1.5) + scale_fill_manual(values=bipal) +
  scale_shape_manual(values=c(fixed=17, mobile=15), guide="none") +
  labs(title="F3 · Activity × enforcement-proximity (high activity/far = priority)") + theme_map()
ggsave2("F3_bivariate.png", F3); F3
message("high-activity & far-from-camera sites: ", sum(sites$x3==3 & sites$y3==1))   # 4
```

## F4 · Enforcement-coverage curve {#f4}

```{r f4}
cov_df <- st_drop_geometry(sites) |> arrange(cam_dist) |>
  mutate(cum = cumsum(vru)/sum(vru))
F4 <- ggplot(cov_df, aes(cam_dist, cum*100)) + geom_step(colour="#08519c", linewidth=.9, direction="hv") +
  geom_vline(xintercept=c(250,500), linetype=3, colour="grey50") +
  labs(title="F4 · Share of VRU activity within distance d of nearest camera",
       x="distance to nearest camera (m)", y="cumulative % of VRU activity") + theme_dep()
ggsave2("F4_coverage_curve.png", F4); F4
for (D in c(100,250,500,1000)) message("<= ", D, " m: ", round(100*max(c(0,cov_df$cum[cov_df$cam_dist<=D])),1), "%")
```

## F5 · Activity clock (hour × day-of-week heatmap, by mode) {#f5}

```{r f5}
days <- c("Mon","Tue","Wed","Thu","Fri","Sat","Sun")
clock <- prof |> group_by(class, dow, hour) |> summarise(count=sum(count), .groups="drop") |>
  group_by(class) |> mutate(share=count/sum(count)) |> ungroup() |>
  mutate(day=factor(days[dow], levels=days))
F5 <- ggplot(clock, aes(day, hour, fill=share)) + geom_tile() +
  facet_wrap(~class) + scale_fill_viridis_c(option="A", labels=percent, name="share") +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks=seq(0,24,3), trans="reverse") +
  labs(title="F5 · When are VRUs active? (share of weekly total)", x="day", y="hour") +
  theme_dep() + theme(panel.grid=element_blank())
ggsave2("F5_activity_clock.png", F5, w=11, h=5); F5
```

## F6 · Seasonal trend + STL decomposition {#f6}

```{r f6}
F6 <- ggplot(daily, aes(date, count, colour=class)) +
  geom_line(alpha=.3, linewidth=.3) +
  geom_line(data=daily |> group_by(class) |> arrange(date) |>
              mutate(roll=zoo::rollmean(count,7,fill=NA)), aes(y=roll), linewidth=1) +
  scale_colour_manual(values=MODE_COL) +
  geom_vline(xintercept=as.numeric(as.Date("2026-04-05")), linetype=3, colour="grey50") +
  labs(title="F6 · Daily pedestrian & cyclist counts, 2026 (7-day mean)", x=NULL, y="daily count") + theme_dep()
ggsave2("F6_seasonal.png", F6, h=4.6); F6
## STL (complex time series): weekly seasonality on daily pedestrian counts
ped <- daily |> filter(class=="pedestrian") |> arrange(date)
ts_ped <- ts(ped$count, frequency=7)
stl_ped <- stl(ts_ped, s.window="periodic", robust=TRUE)
grDevices::png("out/F6b_stl.png", 1300, 900, res=150); plot(stl_ped, main="F6b · STL — daily pedestrian counts"); dev.off()
knitr::include_graphics("out/F6b_stl.png")
```

## F7 · Temporal-behaviour clusters (k-means on weekday+weekend shape) {#f7}

```{r f7}
prof2 <- prof |> mutate(daytype=ifelse(dow<=5,"wd","we")) |>
  group_by(site, daytype, hour) |> summarise(count=sum(count), .groups="drop")
wide <- prof2 |> tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from=c(daytype,hour), values_from=count, values_fill=0)
mat  <- as.matrix(wide[,-1]); rownames(mat) <- wide$site
mat  <- mat / rowSums(mat)                         # share (shape, not volume)
mats <- scale(mat)
sil <- sapply(2:6, function(k){ km <- kmeans(mats, k, nstart=25); mean(cluster::silhouette(km$cluster, dist(mats))[,3]) })
kbest <- (2:6)[which.max(sil)]                     # silhouette-optimal k (=2)
km <- kmeans(mats, kbest, nstart=25)
clus <- tibble(site=rownames(mats), cluster=factor(km$cluster))
g_sil <- ggplot(tibble(k=2:6, sil=sil), aes(k,sil)) + geom_line() + geom_point(size=2) +
  geom_point(data=tibble(k=kbest,sil=max(sil)), colour="#d7301f", size=3) +
  labs(title="F7a · Choosing k (silhouette)", y="avg silhouette") + theme_dep()
sites2 <- left_join(sites, clus, by="site")
g_cmap <- ggplot() + geom_sf(data=com, fill="#f4f4f2", colour="#8a8a8a", linewidth=.5) +
  geom_sf(data=sites2, aes(colour=cluster), size=2.6) + geom_sf(data=cam, aes(shape=kind), size=1.4) +
  scale_colour_brewer(palette="Dark2", name="cluster") + scale_shape_manual(values=c(fixed=17,mobile=15), guide="none") +
  labs(title="F7c · Cluster location + cameras") + theme_map()
F7 <- g_sil | g_cmap; ggsave2("F7_clusters.png", F7, w=13, h=5); F7
print(clus |> count(cluster))                      # commuter (n=23) vs recreational (n=12)
```

## F8 · Time-sliced exposure (small multiples, shared Jenks) {#f8}

```{r f8}
ord <- c("AM peak (7-9)","Midday (10-15)","PM peak (16-18)","Evening/night")
ts_sf <- left_join(sites |> dplyr::select(site), tslice, by="site") |> filter(!is.na(slice)) |>
  mutate(slice=factor(slice, levels=ord))
brk8 <- classInt::classIntervals(ts_sf$count[ts_sf$count>0], 5, "jenks")$brks
ts_sf$cls <- cut(ts_sf$count, brk8, include.lowest=TRUE)
F8 <- ggplot() + geom_sf(data=com, fill="#f4f4f2", colour="#8a8a8a", linewidth=.4) +
  geom_sf(data=cam, shape=4, colour="grey35", size=1) +
  geom_sf(data=ts_sf, aes(size=count, fill=cls), shape=21, colour="black", stroke=.2, alpha=.9) +
  facet_wrap(~slice, nrow=1) +
  scale_fill_manual(values=RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(5,PAL_SEQ), name="VRU (shared Jenks)", drop=FALSE) +
  scale_size_area(max_size=7, guide="none") +
  labs(title="F8 · VRU exposure by time of day (cameras fixed, ×)") + theme_map() + theme(legend.position="bottom")
ggsave2("F8_timeslice.png", F8, w=13, h=4.5); F8
```

## F10 · Connectivity graph (Q3) {#f10}

```{r f10}
bk_l <- suppressWarnings(st_cast(bk, "LINESTRING"))
net  <- sfnetworks::as_sfnetwork(bk_l, directed=FALSE) |>
        tidygraph::convert(sfnetworks::to_spatial_subdivision, .clean=TRUE)   # node shared endpoints
comp <- igraph::components(net)
message("Network: ", comp$no, " components; largest holds ",
        round(100*max(comp$csize)/sum(comp$csize),1), "% of nodes")
net <- net |> tidygraph::activate("edges") |> mutate(btwn = tidygraph::centrality_edge_betweenness())
edges_sf <- net |> tidygraph::activate("edges") |> st_as_sf()
F10 <- ggplot() + geom_sf(data=com, fill="#f4f4f2", colour="#8a8a8a", linewidth=.4) +
  geom_sf(data=edges_sf, aes(colour=btwn), linewidth=.7) +
  scale_colour_viridis_c(option="B", trans="sqrt", name="edge betweenness") +
  labs(title=paste0("F10 · Network importance — ", comp$no, " components")) + theme_map()
ggsave2("F10_network.png", F10); F10
```

## F11 · Synthesis — alignment scorecard {#f11}

```{r f11}
q <- function(x,p) quantile(x, p, na.rm=TRUE)
sites$weak_prot <- sites$prot_m_200==0 | sites$near_prot %in% c("3 Painted on-road","5 Informal / mixed traffic")
sites$priority <- sites$vru >= q(sites$vru,2/3) & sites$cam_dist >= q(sites$cam_dist,2/3) & sites$weak_prot
F11 <- ggplot() + geom_sf(data=com, fill="#f4f4f2", colour="#8a8a8a", linewidth=.4) +
  geom_sf(data=filter(sites,!priority), fill="#fdd0a2", shape=21, size=2.4, colour="white") +
  geom_sf(data=filter(sites, priority), fill="#d7301f", shape=21, size=4, colour="black") +
  geom_sf(data=cam, aes(shape=kind), size=1.5) + scale_shape_manual(values=c(fixed=17,mobile=15), name="camera") +
  labs(title=paste0("F11 · Priority zones (n=", sum(sites$priority), ")")) + theme_map()
ggsave2("F11_synthesis.png", F11); F11
message("priority sites: ", paste(sites$site[sites$priority], collapse=" ; "))
```

# Analytical methods (statistics with caveats) {#methods}

```{r m1-moran}
## Moran's I — is VRU activity spatially clustered? (KNN-5 weights; log VRU)
knn <- spdep::knn2nb(spdep::knearneigh(st_coordinates(sites), k=5))
lw  <- spdep::nb2listw(knn, style="W")
moran <- spdep::moran.test(log1p(sites$vru), lw)
print(moran)                                   # I ~ 0.36, p ~ 0.001 -> significant clustering
## LISA (local Moran) map
lisa <- spdep::localmoran(log1p(sites$vru), lw)
sites$lisa_p <- lisa[,5]; z <- as.numeric(scale(log1p(sites$vru)))
sites$lisa <- ifelse(sites$lisa_p<.05 & z>0, "High-High", ifelse(sites$lisa_p<.05 & z<0, "Low-Low","ns"))
Fm <- ggplot() + geom_sf(data=com, fill="#f4f4f2", colour="#8a8a8a", linewidth=.4) +
  geom_sf(data=sites, aes(colour=lisa), size=2.6) +
  scale_colour_manual(values=c("High-High"="#ca0020","Low-Low"="#0571b0","ns"="grey70")) +
  labs(title="M1 · LISA clusters of VRU activity") + theme_map()
ggsave2("M1_lisa.png", Fm); Fm
```

```{r m3-spearman}
## Spearman association — EXPLORATORY ONLY (spatial autocorrelation breaks independence)
print(suppressWarnings(cor.test(sites$vru, sites$cam_dist, method="spearman")))   # rho ~ -0.15, p ~ 0.39 (ns)
```

```{r appendix-coverage}
Fc <- st_drop_geometry(sites) |> arrange(coverage) |> mutate(rank=row_number()) |>
  ggplot(aes(rank, coverage)) + geom_col(fill="#2c7fb8") + geom_hline(yintercept=.8, linetype=2) +
  labs(title="A1 · Sensor reporting completeness (missing != zero)", x="site (ranked)", y="coverage") + theme_dep()
ggsave2("A1_coverage.png", Fc, h=4); Fc
```
